Designed for modern business environments, it supports Omada Mesh, seamless roaming, and centralised cloud or local management via the Omada platform. Its ultra-slim design allows for discreet installation, while PoE+ and Passive PoE support offer flexible deployment. With advanced features like MU-MIMO, Band Steering, and Load Balancing, the EAP613 ensures fast, stable, and efficient wireless performance across high-density networks.
